text:
rory: FYI — Partner "CloudForge" opened a discrepancy ticket: our marketplace shows higher billable units than their ingestion for several hourly windows yesterday. They flagged an exporter toggle "dedupe=true" rolled out during a canary that might have dropped events. Need partnerships + metering to triage.

emma: ack. can you post the sample they attached?

rory: small excerpt they pasted:
```
2026-03-26T14:00Z,our_units,partner_units
2026-03-26T14:00Z,820,656
2026-03-26T15:00Z,910,728
```

samir: that's ~0.8 again but not exact; dedupe semantics could remove duplicate counts whereas we count raw impressions. Did they change exporter version or just flip a flag?

maria: partner note: "we rolled dedupe=true to canary group at 14:30Z, full rollout at 15:45Z. exporter v3.1.4". They say they didn’t emit rotation events.

jorge: ops options: 1) ask partner to replay the raw bundle for affected windows (preferred), 2) run simulated dedupe on our minute traces to estimate impact, 3) apply provisional credits using a conservative multiplier.

emma: partner is sensitive about device ids; they will share redacted minute traces if we sign the partner-data addendum. Legal ok with 7d TTL and ACL.

samir: for defensibility I'd do this: ingest partner bundle to staging, run our canonical rollup, run partner-sim (dedupe toggled) against our minute-level dataset to reproduce partner_units, produce per-host multipliers and signed audit CSV. That gives them a replayable trail.

jorge: quick ops checklist:```
- provision staging: s3://partners-staging/cloudforge/repro/3223456789/
- request partner upload: minute-ndjson.gz + config.json + sample.hmac
- run recon: recon-tool --window=2026-03-26T13:00Z/2026-03-26T17:00Z
- run simulate-dedupe --policy=last-seen-60s
- diff -> per-host multipliers + signed-audit.csv
```

emma: I'll coordinate partner comms and request the exporter commit sha and canary rollout logs. Ask legal to send addendum link and I'll share presigned URLs once signed.

rory: timeline? they want preliminary numbers for their finance team by EOD ET.

samir: if partner uploads within 2hrs we can stage+run simulations in ~90m. Starting prepare scripts now.

emma: legal sent addendum. partner acknowledged and started upload (upload id: cf-repro-3223456789).

billing-bot: Billing anomaly created: partner=cloudforge id=CF-9932 window=2026-03-26 impact_est=~$4,200 status=open

jorge: ingest succeeded. running canonical rollup now (job: recon-3223456789).

samir: simulation done. preliminary reproduction: simulated dedupe explains ~19.9% drop in partner units for affected windows. Per-host multipliers attached (median 1.246). Saving signed audit CSV to s3://partners-audit/cloudforge/3223456789/.

emma: shared the recon report and options: 1) immediate one-off credit for validated windows with audit CSV, 2) update entitlement mapping to accept exporter metadata and normalize going forward. Partner prefers credit + roadmap item to normalize metadata.

rory: good. billing, please hold auto-adjusts and prepare manual credit path pending finance approval.

billing-bot: Acknowledged. auto-adjusts paused for CF-9932. Manual credit flagged for review.

maria: follow-up: schedule a postmortem with CloudForge and ask them to include exporter pre-deploy checklist so future flag flips are announced.

emma: will schedule. closing this thread for ops; will reopen if partner finds discrepancies in the audit. :white_check_mark:
